decisions: Frequency interpolation uses amplitude and unwrapped phase after time interpolation, compresses unflagged samples, and uses nearest endpoint extrapolation. Cubic interior interpolation requires four valid samples and raises atomically with fewer, as CASA does.

Preserve identity, positive broadcast, explicit-prefix and first-available(-999) mapping for windows present when setapply is called. New windows observed afterward remain explicitly unfinished under #1053; do not partially implement whole-step coverage inside frequency interpolation.

Complete natural-spline back-substitution at every interior knot under the standing evident-intent correction. Raw CASA and independent exact-amplitude sampled-CASA controls remain separate; no tolerance changes.

Admit calibration payload counts using ordinary storage shape headers, before loading values. Each physical checkout owns its caches; all source timestamps were refreshed before first debug/release builds from copied caches. No new format or third-party dependency.

Unavailable whole calibration windows stay explicit #1053 refusals, distinct from a missing antenna in an available window. This preserves DATA atomically until whole-step Jones/noise/scratch coverage is completed.
